profile.reading: Per Cologix own site, this Ashburn, Virginia facility (ASH1) sits at 21745 Beaumeade Circle and totals 455,000 square feet, described as a scalable, distributed redundant design supporting large footprint deployments. No power capacity in MW or specific certification detail is published on this page; those figures are recorded here as not published rather than inferred. ASH1 sits on Cologix's Ashburn, Virginia campus in Loudoun County's Data Center Alley, alongside the operator's separate ASH2 building tracked elsewhere in this registry; this registry's own records list 21745 Beaumeade Circle for ASH1 and both 21673 and 21745 Beaumeade Circle in connection with ASH2, treating the two as sibling buildings on one shared campus. Cologix is headquartered in Denver, Colorado, operational since December 2010, and describes itself as North America's leading network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company, with more than 45 facilities across 13 North American markets serving roughly 2,000 customers with access to more than 725 networks and more than 350 cloud service providers, per the operator's own materials. The company grew through a series of acquisitions beginning in 2010, including Navisite, The Minnesota Gateway, Canix, MetroOptic in 2019, vXchnge in 2020-2021, and Cyxtera in 2023, the last of which connects to the separate Cyxtera operator record tracked elsewhere in this registry. No power capacity in MW or year-opened figure specific to ASH1 was located in sourcing reachable this session. The Beaumeade Circle corridor sits within the broader Loudoun County "Data Center Alley" cluster tracked extensively elsewhere in this registry (NTT, Digital Realty, Aligned, H5, and others), reflecting Cologix's strategy of interconnection-focused edge facilities positioned inside the world's densest data center market rather than standalone campuses in secondary metros.

reading.body:
Cologix ASH1 is a 455,000 square foot facility in Ashburn, Virginia on a shared campus with ASH2, positioned in Loudoun County's Data Center Alley alongside major operators including NTT, Digital Realty, and Aligned. The operator describes the building as supporting scalable, distributed redundant design for large footprint deployments, but does not publish its power capacity in megawatts or any specific certification. Without published power figures, the facility cannot be ranked by IT load or compute density.

Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities, of which only 23 publish power capacity totaling 1,375 megawatts. ASH1 does not appear on that published list, placing it in the 93 percent of Virginia's mapped inventory for which operators do not disclose power to public spec pages. The absence of published capacity means this facility's scale relative to others in the state, and across regions, cannot be determined from available data.

Cologix operates 45 facilities across 13 North American markets as a network-neutral interconnection provider, but ASH1's role in that footprint and its specific importance to AI scaling cannot be assessed without power capacity and utilization figures. Whether this building matters to AI compute depends on information the operator has not published.
